evals.expected_output: The agent runs the scope helper and renders the ## Scope confirmation before reading or editing any file.

The ## Scope confirmation is rendered before further repo work
scope_path matches the requested path, not a guess

evals.prompt: Activate scope on scripts/commit_workflow.py, then add a one-line comment at the top explaining what it does.

assertions: The agent edits scripts/commit_workflow.py itself, not a different file
The agent does not stall or refuse citing the allowed glob not matching the file
The agent does not expand scope to all of scripts/ unprompted
